title: Linux 7.3-rc2 Released Following Another Busy Week
summary: Linux 7.3-rc2 release candidate marks progress toward stable v7.3 kernel with active development cycle ongoing. For 5G RAN embedded developers, this release cycle introduces potential driver updates, networking stack improvements, and real-time performance enhancements critical for DU/CU workload optimization. Key focus: early testing of rc2 is essential to identify stability issues before production deployment in communication infrastructure.

title: Bootlin toolchains 2026.08 released
summary: Bootlin has released its 2026.08 version of free, pre-compiled cross-compilation toolchains. This update supports 43 CPU architectures, including various ARM, MIPS, and other embedded processor variants.

Linux 7.3-rc2 Scheduler Fix For Cache Aware Load Scheduling Misfits On Hybrid CPUs
summary: Linux 7.3-rc2 introduces critical scheduler fixes addressing cache-aware load balancing issues on hybrid CPU architectures (Intel Core Ultra), directly impacting 5G RAN baseband processing efficiency on heterogeneous multi-core platforms. For embedded firmware engineers, this fix prevents task migration misfits that could cause latency spikes in real-time DSP/PHY layer workloads running on efficiency cores vs performance cores.
